name: Glass
overview: Scripture uses glass both literally and symbolically to convey purity, value, and divine beauty. Job 28:17 contrasts the incomparable worth of wisdom with precious materials like crystal and gold, highlighting the surpassing excellence of God's gifts. In Revelation, the 'sea of glass' mingled with fire (15:2) symbolizes the victorious and purified presence of the redeemed, while the New Jerusalem is described with walls and streets likened to clear and transparent glass (21:18, 21), emphasizing the city's holiness and the perfect clarity of God's eternal kingdom.
